propositions: After commit 465d's module split, all search_issues calls were moved out of transport.py into _base.py and _issues.py, but the pagination structural guard remained pinned to scan only transport.py, causing the guard to become vacuous (population zero).

The guard's AST predicate _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() scans a single hardcoded file path that no longer contains the construct it polices, returning an empty list and making assert not offenders unconditionally true.

The widened scan must cover every *.py module in adapters/jira_datacenter/ and include a non-vacuity assertion requiring the scan to observe at least one search_issues call site, preventing the guard from silently disarming if future code moves empty the directory again.

Two new teeth tests must prove the widened predicate catches synthetic uncapped calls attributed to non-transport modules, demonstrating the directory glob (not just the string-source path) is actually exercised.
A parallel audit found four additional single-file AST structural guards across the codebase vacuously emptied by the same 465d split mechanism, reported separately as sibling bug 8a5e.
